no_context.request: Monthly on-time rate for Tahani, whole year.
no_context.text: Here is the monthly on-time rate. I compared each delivery scan with the promised time.
no_context.code:
result = con.sql("""
    SELECT strftime(d.created_at, '%Y-%m') AS month,
           COUNT(*) AS deliveries,
           AVG(CASE WHEN s.scan_time_utc <= d.promised_by THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS on_time_rate
    FROM deliveries d
    JOIN scans s ON s.delivery_id = d.delivery_id AND s.outcome = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
""").df()
headline = {"on_time_rate": float((result.on_time_rate * result.deliveries).sum() / result.deliveries.sum())}

with_context.request: Monthly on-time rate for Tahani, whole year.
with_context.text: Monthly on-time rate under D-2 for every month of created_at, delivered parcels, test shipments removed, local times.
with_context.code:
result = con.sql("""
    WITH base AS (
        SELECT d.*, (d.delivered_at <= d.promised_by) AS ok
        FROM deliveries d
        JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = d.customer_id
        WHERE c.segment <> 'TEST' AND d.status = 'delivered'
    )
    SELECT strftime(created_at, '%Y-%m') AS month,
           COUNT(*) AS deliveries,
           AVG(CASE WHEN ok THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS on_time_rate
    FROM base
    GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
""").df()
headline = {"on_time_rate": float((result.on_time_rate * result.deliveries).sum() / result.deliveries.sum())}
